_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to eval/judgements-test.json and fill it in.
Deliberately NOT named judgements-test.json so the real file stays absent until a
fluent Arabic reviewer produces it. Until then every report prints:
human: no judgements recorded (human review not performed)
and no model selection may be recorded.
Schema: one object per item. verdict must be exactly one of:
win       the reviewed output is better
loss      the reviewed output is worse
unusable  the output is not Arabic, or is otherwise unusable
reviewer must be non-empty. note is optional but is where the judgement that
automatic metrics cannot make gets written.
Only the 'test' split is judged; the dev split is for development.
_how_to_produce: 2. Have a fluent Arabic reviewer read each line and judge the output against the reference.
3. Record one object per item below, using the itemId exactly as printed.
4. Re-run the benchmark; the report will then carry the human section.
